items.name: gothic-cathedral
items.text: a gothic cathedral west front, flying buttresses and pinnacles around a rose window of carved stone lace, limestone soot-darkened in the reveals

items.name: brutalist-tower
items.text: a monolithic brutalist tower, raw board-marked concrete printing its plank grain, deep window reveals cutting hard shadow grids against a flat sky

items.name: japanese-temple
items.text: a cypress-wood temple hall, sweeping tiled eaves upturned at the corners over stacked bracket clusters, bronze fittings weathered green

items.name: art-deco-skyscraper
items.text: an art-deco skyscraper crown, stepped limestone setbacks narrowing to a chrome-nickel spire, gilded zigzag spandrels and eagle gargoyles guarding the corners

items.name: glass-parametric
items.text: a flowing parametric glass building, no two panels alike, sky reflections shearing along the twisting curtain wall

items.name: half-timbered-row
items.text: a leaning row of half-timbered medieval townhouses, oak frames and cream plaster infill, jettied upper floors sagging toward the lane

items.name: desert-adobe
items.text: sculpted adobe architecture, hand-smoothed earthen plaster rounding every corner, projecting vigas dotting shadow down the wall, deep-set openings holding cool shade

items.name: stave-church
items.text: a black-tarred stave church, dragon heads carved on the gable peaks, cedar shingles lapped like scales down the tiered roofs

items.name: stilt-village
items.text: a stilt village walking over calm water on tide-stained timber legs, plank walkways linking tin-roofed houses

items.name: opera-shells
items.text: a sail-shelled opera house, white ceramic chevron tiles curving overhead, harbor light bouncing up the vaults

items.name: moorish-courtyard
items.text: a Moorish courtyard, horseshoe arches on slender marble columns, emerald and cobalt zellige mosaic, carved stucco lace above a still fountain

items.name: arcology-megastructure
items.text: a terraced arcology megastructure, hanging gardens on every setback, aviation lights blinking as the upper tiers dissolve into cloud

items.name: alpine-chalet
items.text: a stone-based alpine chalet, weathered larch balconies under deep snow eaves fringed with icicles, one window glowing

items.name: lighthouse-headland
items.text: a striped lighthouse braced on a storm-worn headland, spray bursting white at the base of the cliff

items.name: glass-pavilion
items.text: a modernist glass pavilion hovering on a travertine plinth, floor-to-ceiling glazing dissolving the wall between lawn and interior, steel columns thin as pencil lines

items.name: five-storey-pagoda
items.text: a five-storey timber pagoda, each tiled roof tier smaller than the last, wind chimes at the eave corners, a bronze finial spearing the sky

items.name: onion-dome-church
items.text: a cluster of candy-striped and gilded onion domes on white drum towers, crosses flashing above green copper roofs

items.name: blue-tiled-mosque
items.text: a mosque dome sheathed in turquoise tile, muqarnas honeycomb shading the portal, twin minarets framing the drum

items.name: cliff-monastery
items.text: a monastery fused into a sheer cliff face, whitewashed walls growing out of raw rock, timber galleries hanging over the drop

items.name: hakka-tulou
items.text: a circular Hakka tulou fortress, rammed-earth ring wall four storeys high, tiered timber galleries facing the round inner courtyard, one gate through walls a metre thick

items.name: victorian-palm-house
items.text: a Victorian palm house, curved wrought-iron ribs carrying thousands of overlapping glass panes, palm crowns pressing against the misted vault

items.name: cantilevered-cabin
items.text: a blackened-timber cabin cantilevered off a granite ledge, one picture window aimed down the valley, the steel underpinning hidden so the box appears to float
